---
title: "Bancos y cuentas"
---

```{=html}

<div class="tf-page-header">
  <div>
    <h1>Bancos y cuentas</h1>
    <div class="tf-muted">Cuentas agrupadas por banco o institución. El detalle y la edición se abren solo cuando los necesitas.</div>
  </div>
  <button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button>
</div>

<div class="tf-actions" style="margin-bottom:1rem">
  <button id="account-new" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">+ Nueva cuenta</button>
  <button id="account-archived-toggle" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button" hidden>Archivadas</button>
</div>

<div id="accounts-root"></div>

<dialog id="account-detail" class="tf-modal-dialog tf-account-detail-dialog">
  <div class="tf-modal-head">
    <div>
      <div class="tf-section-kicker">Cuenta</div>
      <h2 id="account-detail-title">Detalle de cuenta</h2>
    </div>
    <button id="account-detail-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary tf-btn-compact" type="button">Cerrar</button>
  </div>
  <div id="account-detail-body" class="tf-account-detail-body"></div>
</dialog>

<dialog id="account-editor" class="tf-modal-dialog tf-account-editor-dialog">
  <div class="tf-modal-head tf-account-editor-head">
    <div>
      <div class="tf-section-kicker">Cuenta bancaria</div>
      <h2 id="account-editor-title">Nueva cuenta</h2>
    </div>
    <button id="account-editor-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary tf-btn-compact" type="button">Cerrar</button>
  </div>

  <form id="account-form" class="tf-account-editor-form">
    <select id="account-type" hidden aria-hidden="true">
      <option value="savings">Ahorros</option>
      <option value="checking">Corriente</option>
      <option value="credit_card">Tarjeta de crédito</option>
      <option value="cash">Efectivo / billetera</option>
    </select>

    <div class="tf-account-static-pane">
      <div class="tf-account-type-switch" role="group" aria-label="Tipo de cuenta">
        <button type="button" class="tf-account-type-btn" data-account-type="savings">Ahorros</button>
        <button type="button" class="tf-account-type-btn" data-account-type="checking">Corriente</button>
        <button type="button" class="tf-account-type-btn" data-account-type="credit_card">Tarjeta</button>
        <button type="button" class="tf-account-type-btn" data-account-type="cash">Efectivo</button>
      </div>

      <div class="tf-account-opening-block">
        <label id="opening-label" for="opening-balance">Saldo inicial</label>
        <div class="tf-account-opening-input-wrap">
          <span>$</span>
          <input id="opening-balance" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" placeholder="0,00" value="0" required>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="tf-account-details-scroll">
      <div class="tf-tx-details-title">
        <div class="tf-section-kicker">Detalles</div>
        <span>Institución, alias, fecha base y configuración de la cuenta</span>
      </div>

      <div class="tf-form-grid">
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Banco / institución</label><input id="bank" autocomplete="organization" required></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Alias</label><input id="alias" autocomplete="off" required></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Últimos 4 dígitos</label><input id="last4" type="text" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="4" pattern="[0-9]{0,4}" autocomplete="off" placeholder="1234"></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha base del saldo inicial</label><input id="opening-balance-as-of" type="date" required><div class="tf-muted">Los movimientos desde esta fecha forman parte del saldo de la cuenta.</div></div>
      </div>

      <div id="credit-fields" class="tf-subtle" hidden>
        <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><strong>Detalles de tarjeta de crédito</strong></div></div>
        <div class="tf-form-grid" style="margin-top:.7rem">
          <div class="tf-field"><label>Cupo total ($)</label><input id="credit-limit" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" value="0"></div>
          <div class="tf-field"><label>Día de corte</label><input id="closing-day" type="text" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="2" value="18"></div>
          <div class="tf-field"><label>Día de pago</label><input id="payment-day" type="text" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="2" value="5"></div>
          <div class="tf-field"><label>Recordar (días antes)</label><input id="card-reminder" type="text" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="2" value="3"></div>
          <div class="tf-field"><label>Saldo estado actual ($)</label><input id="statement-balance" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" value="0"></div>
          <div class="tf-field"><label>Pago mínimo ($)</label><input id="minimum-payment" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" value="0"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="tf-account-save-bar">
      <button id="account-cancel" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cancelar</button>
      <button id="account-submit" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="submit">Guardar cuenta</button>
    </div>
  </form>
</dialog>

<script type="module" src="js/accounts-v1.js?v=1.0.82"></script>
```
